_documentation_: To change how a sprite sheet is loaded, add it as an entry here, with the relative path as key and the value being as described below. If a folder is listed, it is applied to all images in the folder, that are not separately listed.

_values_.normal: Load a grid of variants from the image. This is the default.
_values_.single: Load a single sprite from the image, don't split into multiple variants.
_values_.static: Load a single sprite from the image and use that for all variants.
_values_._path_: Details on how to load sprites from the image are in that json file.
